items.title: CVE-2026-102764 · BeyondTrust Remote Support: BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
items.summary: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

items.title: CVE-2025-61624 · Fortinet Multiple Products: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.summary: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

items.summary: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

items.title: CVE-2026-105134 · Ahsay AhsayCBS: Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability
items.summary: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

items.title: CVE-2026-76519 · Cisco Secure Email Gateway: Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.summary: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

items.summary: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

items.title: CVE-2026-0322 · Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

items.title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
items.summary: Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today's epic patch batch dwarfs September's record of nearly 1,000 fixes, which was already about ten times the normal monthly patch load from Redmond.

items.title: CVE-2026-104935 · Ivanti Connect Secure: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
items.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

items.summary: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

items.title: CVE-2015-5477 · ISC BIND:  ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability
items.summary: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

items.title: CVE-2016-3081 · Apache Struts: Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability
items.summary: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

items.title: CVE-2023-22894 · Strapi Strapi: Strapi Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
items.summary: Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-22621 to achieve remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2021-3199 · ONLYOFFICE Docs: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.summary: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

items.summary: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

items.title: CVE-2026-88779 · Citrix NetScaler: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
items.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-102490 · Zammad GmbH Zammad: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
items.summary: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

items.title: CVE-2026-102489 · Zammad GmbH Zammad: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
items.summary: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

items.summary: Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

items.title: CVE-2026-76504 · Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
items.summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

items.title: CVE-2026-86950 · Apple Multiple Products: Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
items.summary: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

items.title: CVE-2026-67279 · MikroTik RouterOS: Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
items.summary: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.

items.title: CVE-2026-65660 · Microsoft SharePoint: Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability
items.summary: Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

items.title: CVE-2026-87902 · WordPress Core: WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
items.summary: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-5430 · WSO2 Multiple Products: WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.summary: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-71362 · Adobe Commerce and Magento : Adobe Commerce and Magento Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: Adobe Commerce and Magento contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction.

items.title: CVE-2026-93952 · Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
items.summary: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem contains an improper input validation vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

items.title: CVE-2026-94127 · F5 BIG-IP APM: F5 BIG-IP APM Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
items.summary: F5 BIG-IP APM contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability when access policy and an OAuth profile are configured on a virtual server. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-93616 · Check Point Multiple Products: Check Point Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.summary: Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.

items.title: CVE-2026-85102 · Check Point Multiple Products: Check Point Multiple Products Improper Certificate Validation Vulnerability
items.summary: Check Point Security Gateway and Check Point Spark Firewall using Site to Site VPN or Remote Access VPN contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Gateway.

items.title: CVE-2026-7273 · Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches: Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
items.summary: Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.

items.title: CVE-2025-39964 · Linux Kernel: Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
items.summary: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.

items.title: CVE-2026-53266 · Linux Kernel: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
items.summary: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ebtables SNAT target which allows an ARP sender hardware address rewrite to write directly into a nonlinear socket-buffer fragment backed by a splice-imported file page. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.
